How to clear cached go module dependencies

by Connor Kuljis

To clean the Go module cache, you can use the following command:

go clean -modcache

This will remove all cached module files from the Go module cache directory.

This is useful when building a Go project and you want to ensure that you are using the latest versions of the modules without any cached versions interfering.
